block1.whyPulseDoesnT: Why Pulse doesn't use a bot
block1.momentRecorderHasJoined: The moment “Recorder has joined” appears in a meeting, the air changes a little. We never thought that change was a fair trade for the convenience of a recording.
block1.pulseDoesnTJoin: Pulse doesn't join the meeting. It records the audio your computer plays and your microphone, straight from your desktop. Nothing appears on anyone else's screen, and it works the same in Zoom, Teams or in person.
block1.botToolsAutoJoin: Bot tools auto-join whatever is on the calendar. With Pulse you start and stop the recording yourself. Meetings you don't want captured aren't.
block1.consentObtainedHostNot: Consent is obtained by the host, not the tool. Pulse supports that with invite templates and org-wide notification settings.
block1.notUsingBotChoice: Not using a bot is a choice, not a limitation. A tool that improves meetings shouldn't get in their way.

block2.reBuildingCategoryDefining: We're building a category-defining product in Tokyo, used daily by sales, CS and leadership teams. If your heart jumps a little when you read what's below, reach out.

block3.makeDentUniverse: Make our dent in the universe
block3.veAlwaysAdmiredComputing: We've always admired computing pioneers from the 60s, 70s and 80s – the folks who dreamed big and built the foundations of the digital world. With LLMs and intelligent systems changing the world, we believe this is our moment.
block3.buildingGreatProductRare: Building a great product is rare. It takes a lot of care, love, and effort on the part of the people building it. We are a group of humans that care about each other, and make each other better.
block3.designedTokyoBuiltJapanese: Designed in Tokyo, built for Japanese work
block3.japaneseMeetingsJapaneseBusiness: Japanese meetings, Japanese business tools, Japanese consent norms. Pulse is built for the Japanese workplace from day one.

heroL.turnMeetingNotesInto: Turn meeting notes into company knowledge
heroL.pulseCapturesWhatMatters: Pulse captures what matters and connects it to your teams' apps and AI tools, giving everyone the same context to work from. It works for all meeting types and platforms with built-in security and governance to reduce IT overhead.

block2.conversationDataNeverUsed: Your conversation data is never used to train AI models

block2.adminsCanTurnNotifications: Admins can turn on notifications for everyone in the workspace
block2.spendLotTimeHard: We spend a lot of time on the hard parts about meeting notes—not just who said what, but why it was said and what it means for your team. It’s a small distinction, but it’s the one that makes notes worth reading instead of just forgetting.
block2.donTJustFeed: We don’t just feed transcripts into an AI model. We’ve built our own infrastructure to parse the nuances to capture intent, tone, and emphasis.
block2.builtWhereverConversationHappens: Built for wherever the conversation happens
block2.whetherSZoomTeams: Whether it’s Zoom, Teams, GMeet, in person, on a call, over Slack Huddle, or even from your watch, Pulse can take notes.

block3.mostImportantConversationsHappen: The most important conversations happen in meetings and it’s important to keep that information safe. Pulse meets the bar for every enterprise and offers built-in tools to make sure that participants are informed and admins have control of how their data is handled.
block3.controlSharingIntegrationsRetention: Control sharing, integrations and retention per workspace.
block3.samlSsoDirectorySync: SAML SSO and directory sync automate onboarding and offboarding.

during, and after a call
block3.prepBriefJotLine: Prep with a Brief, jot a line during the call, and get actions and follow-ups afterwards. Adoption is fast because there is little to learn.

block3.pulseSpreadsBottomUp: Pulse spreads bottom-up: one person starts, colleagues see shared notes and follow. IT keeps that growth inside safe boundaries with admin controls.

block1.accountDetailsNameEmail: Account details (name, email, company), the notes and transcripts you create, app usage, and calendar events from connected calendars. Meeting audio is discarded after transcription and never stored.
block1.provideImproveServiceSupport: To provide and improve the Service, support you, keep it secure and comply with law. We do not train AI models on your data.
block1.useTranscriptionAiCloud: We use transcription, AI and cloud infrastructure providers to deliver the Service. The list is published on our subprocessor page.
block1.dataStoredEncryptedRegion: Data is stored encrypted in-region and retained until you delete it. Enterprise plans can set auto-deletion periods.
block1.encryptionRestTransitAccess: Encryption at rest and in transit, access controls, audit logs and staff training.
block1.mayRequestAccessCorrection: You may request access, correction, deletion or suspension of your personal data from within the app or by contacting us.
block1.websiteUsesCookiesConvenience: Our website uses cookies for convenience and analytics; disable them in your browser.
block1.changesPolicyWillPosted: Changes to this policy will be posted on our website.

heroL.securityPrivacyHowWorks: Security, privacy, and how it all works
heroL.securityPrivacyUtmostImportance: Your security and privacy are of utmost importance to us. Find the most important details below, followed by FAQs, and then links to all our terms and policies at the bottom of this page.
heroL.encourageSecurityVulnerabilityReports: We encourage security vulnerability reports and maintain a public Vulnerability Disclosure Policy with reporting guidelines and procedures.

block2.pulseAppDesktopMacos: Pulse is an app for Desktop (macOS and Windows), a lot like Apple Notes or Notion. It works with Google Workspace or Microsoft login and integrates with your calendar.
block2.haveManuallyStartPulse: You have to manually start Pulse for a meeting (it won't auto-join or auto-record anything). Pulse then accesses your microphone audio, and audio on your computer, and transcribes it. It does not add a bot to your video call.
block2.pulseWorksAnyMeeting: Pulse works with any meeting platform. Zoom, Meet, Teams, you name it.
block2.pulseUsesBestClass: Pulse uses best-in-class transcription providers and AI providers to summarize your meeting.
block2.doNotAllowThird: We do not allow third parties (like OpenAI or Anthropic) to use your data to train their AI models.
block2.pulseDoesNotTrain: Pulse does not train on your data either.
block2.pulseDoesnTStore: Pulse doesn't store the audio from meetings - it transcribes in real time and discards temporarily cached audio after processing. It only stores the transcript and any notes you provide from a call.
block2.controlWhoSeesNotes: You control who sees your notes
block2.userControlWhoSees: As a user, you control who sees your notes. Notes are private by default, until you choose to share them with others.
block2.canDeleteIndividualNotes: You can delete individual notes, or request deletion of all your data at any time.
block2.everythingStoredIndustryStandard: Everything stored in industry standard, encrypted infrastructure
block2.notesStoredRegionVirtual: Notes are stored in an in-region Virtual Private Cloud. They are encrypted at rest and in transit. They are backed up daily.
block2.reHereIfNeed: We're here if you need us
block2.ifHaveMoreQuestions: If you have more questions, please reach out to our team.
block2.rePreparingIndependentSoc: We're preparing an independent SOC 2 Type II audit of our security practices.
block2.reCommittedGdprAppi: We're committed to GDPR and APPI compliance and have a Data Processing Agreement available upon request.

block3.howDoesPulseSecure: How does Pulse secure customer data?
block3.encryptionRestTransitLeast: Encryption at rest and in transit, least-privilege access, audit logs and vulnerability scanning.
block3.doesPulseWorkLocally: Does Pulse work locally or send data to the cloud?
block3.audioCapturedLocallySent: Audio is captured locally and sent encrypted to the cloud only for transcription and summarization. Audio is not stored.
block3.howDoesPulseManage: How does Pulse manage security vulnerabilities?
block3.regularDependencyScanningPublic: Regular dependency scanning and a public vulnerability disclosure policy.
block3.annualThirdPartyPenetration: Annual third-party penetration tests are planned.
block3.doesPulseHaveAny: Does Pulse have any security certifications?
block3.soc2TypeIi: SOC 2 Type II is in progress; ISMS is planned.
block3.howCanIReport: How can I report security vulnerabilities?
block3.emailSecurityLlFollow: Email security@ and we'll follow our disclosure policy.

block4.publishListTranscriptionAi: We publish a list of transcription, AI and infrastructure providers and notify before changes.
block4.untilDeleteEnterpriseCan: Until you delete it. Enterprise can set auto-deletion periods.
block4.exportNotesTranscriptsMarkdown: Export notes and transcripts as markdown or JSON at any time.
